NAME
time_ns() - return the number of nanoseconds since January 1, 1970

SYNOPSIS
int time_ns( void );

DESCRIPTION
Returns the number of nanoseconds since midnight (GMT) on January 1, 1970.

Added on May 30, 2023 in branch 3478cc2.

SEE ALSO
time(3), ctime(3), localtime(3), time_expression(3), uptime(3), perf_counter_ns(3)
